title: Billing Inquiries, Out-of-Allowance Charges, and Roaming Disputes
summary: Guidelines for resolving customer invoice disputes, international roaming charges, and applying one-time courtesy bill adjustments.

sections.heading: International Roaming Zones and Rates
sections.text: Mobile roaming is classified into three zones: Zone 1 (EU/EEA) included in domestic allowances; Zone 2 (USA, Canada, Australia) covered by $6.00/day Roaming Pass; Zone 3 (Rest of World, including Switzerland, Monaco, UAE) billed at standard out-of-allowance rate of $0.25/MB ($25.00/100MB) unless a World Travel Bolt-On is pre-purchased.

sections.heading: First-Time Roaming Dispute Courtesy Policy
sections.text: Support agents are authorized to offer a one-time goodwill courtesy credit of up to 50% (maximum $50.00) of first-time disputed Zone 2 or Zone 3 roaming data charges if the customer confirms they were unaware data roaming was active on their device and sets up a data roaming spending cap.

sections.heading: Mid-Contract Adjustments & Payment Arrangements
sections.text: Regular monthly charges are billed 30 days in advance; usage-based fees in arrears. Customers disputing an invoice balance exceeding $100.00 may defer the disputed portion for 14 business days pending review or initiate a 3-month split installment plan without suspension.
